description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates how to use custom fonts with the Typeface class in Android. It creates a view that draws text with default and custom fonts.

classes.name: Typefaces
classes.description: An Android activity for demonstrating custom font usage via drawing text on a canvas.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that overrides onDraw to display text with default and custom typefaces.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that loads a custom font from assets and sets up paint properties.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering the sample text with different typefaces on the canvas.
